# Recordings Directory

| File | Type | Duration | Notes |
|------|------|----------|-------|
| `speaker_auto_recording.wav` | Smart speaker auto-alert | ~40s | Use omni subagent |
| `speaker_auto_transcript.txt` | Auto-generated transcript | — | May contain errors |
| `householder_nanny_call.wav` | SVP ↔ nanny phone call | ~2 min | Use omni subagent |

**Important**: The .txt transcript is auto-generated and may contain errors.
The wav files are the authoritative record. For critical values (humidity
readings, timing windows), always use an omni-capable subagent to process
the wav directly rather than relying on the text transcript.
